name: daily_stock_analysis
description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
one_liner: A free, run-it-yourself robot analyst that reads stock news and prices every day across multiple markets and pushes you a plain-English buy/watch/avoid summary.
buyer: A retail investor managing their own portfolio who can't afford a Bloomberg Terminal or a financial analyst but wants a daily digest instead of doomscrolling financial news.
business_use_cases: A retail trader schedules it to run every morning on a free cloud tier and gets a push notification before market open instead of paying for a stock-alert service.
A finance content creator uses its automated analysis as a daily talking-points generator for a newsletter or video script.
A small registered investment advisor uses the underlying pipeline internally as a cheap first-pass screener before a human analyst digs deeper.

money_ideas.idea: Host it and sell subscriptions to the daily digest with extra markets, watchlists, and premium data sources
White-label the dashboard for finance influencers who want to offer 'my daily picks' without building it themselves

steal_this: Stand up a hosted version with a clean dashboard and a free daily email digest, then upsell a paid tier with more tickers and SMS alerts — but get real legal advice first, since selling stock analysis commercially can brush up against investment-advice regulation.
